Fire and Life Safety America will also enter the units to inspect the sprinkler heads and fire extinguishers inside every room. Residents cannot remove these items during inspections. They will only be entering rooms on inspection days, which are the only days they will be here. All pets should stay put and alarms off. The text says: "Today, we celebrate the resurrection of Jesus Christ, your Beloved Son, with His holy Father, and Paul the Apostle. We are gathered here today to commemorate this great mystery which has been unfolding for so long. This is a momentous occasion. The Holy Spirit, who was promised to us from the beginning, will now be revealed in his full glory at this most sacred time." The question asked is: "What exactly does the word 'ascended' mean? Seen on August 18 we celebrate the ascension of our Lord Jesus into heaven. The Collectors declare that Mary is assumed into heaven. There is a difference here: Christ was assumed, Mary is not yet assumed. He is both fully God and fully man as the Second Person of the Trinity. This mystery so great that we cannot understand it completely. Mary is still only human, the soul not possessing the divine nature, as Christ has. This is why she could not ascend into heaven as Christ did; She ascends up into heaven, and we say that he was assumed." The answer to the question is: "Mary is still only human, the soul not possessing the divine nature, as Christ has."
